title: 'Here to stay' - Fans react to the rise of soccer in the US
originalTitle: 'Here to stay' - Fans react to the rise of soccer in the US
content:
Since the 2026 World Cup kicked off, stadiums in the United States have drawn large crowds and the games have generated widespread interest across the country. The BBC's Nardine Saad spoke to soccer fans about whether they think the sport is becoming more popular in the US.
